# Pinnacle Treatment Centers

> > Pinnacle Treatment Centers provides evidence-based addiction treatment for opioid use disorder, alcohol use disorder, and prescription drug addiction through medication-assisted treatment and community-based care.

Pinnacle Treatment Centers operates facilities across the United States, offering comprehensive substance use disorder treatment including MAT (Medication-Assisted Treatment) for opioids, alcohol, benzodiazepines, and stimulants. The organization emphasizes community-based treatment approaches, harm reduction, and evidence-based care for individuals and families affected by addiction.

## Key Topics

- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Opioid Use Disorder
- Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD)
- Substance Use Disorder
- Addiction Recovery
- Overdose Prevention
- Prescription Drug Addiction
- Co-Occurring Disorders
- Relapse Prevention
- Community-Based Treatment
- Opioid Crisis
- Heroin Addiction
- Benzodiazepine Addiction
- Harm Reduction
- Evidence-Based Treatment

## Core Treatment Services

- [Substance Use Disorders & Addiction](https://pinnacletreatment.com/addiction): Main addiction treatment page covering opioids, alcohol, benzos, stimulants
- [Prescription Drug Addiction: Symptoms, Causes & Treatment](https://pinnacletreatment.com/addiction/prescription-drug-abuse): Prescription drug addiction treatment including opioids, benzos, stimulants

## Opioid Use Disorder Treatment

- [Opioid Addiction: Symptoms, Causes & Treatment](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/what-causes-opioid-addiction): Comprehensive guide to opioid addiction symptoms, causes, and MAT treatment
- [Opioid Addiction During Pregnancy](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/opioid-addiction-pregnancy): Risks of opioid use during pregnancy and maternal health impacts
- [Can Cannabinoids or Medical Cannabis Treat Opioid Addiction?](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/cannabinoids-opiate-addiction): Analysis of cannabinoids and medical cannabis for opioid use disorder
- [Opioid-Induced Itching - Why Do Hydrocodone, Narcotics Make You Itchy?](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/opioid-itch): Explains opioid-induced itching side effects from hydrocodone and narcotics
- [Opioid Crisis Led to Prescription Monitoring, But Did It Help?](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/opioid-prescription-monitoring): Analysis of prescription monitoring programs and unintended consequences
- [The Opioid Crisis in Kenton County, KY](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/opioid-crisis-kenton-co-kentucky): Kenton County Kentucky opioid epidemic statistics and harm reduction efforts

## Alcohol Use Disorder Treatment

- [Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD): Symptoms, Causes & Treatment](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/treating-alcohol-use-disorder): Comprehensive guide to AUD symptoms, causes, and evidence-based treatment
- [Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD): Symptoms, Causes & Treatment](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/understanding-alcohol-abuse-treatment-options): AUD treatment options guide with symptoms and evidence-based care approaches
- [The Neurobiology of Addiction & the Alcohol Craving Circuit](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/neurobiology-alcohol-addiction): Brain science of alcohol craving circuits and neural addiction pathways
- [Blood Pressure Medication Reduces Withdrawal Symptoms](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/blood-pressure-medication): Prazosin medication for reducing alcohol withdrawal symptoms

- [Community-Based Treatment](https://pinnacletreatment.com/blog/going-local-the-advantages-of-community-based-treatment): Benefits of community-based substance use disorder treatment near home
